full_details: In the night you woke once and thought only of where the Prince stands. In the morning the latch was mended. It shut the first time. Mistress Ansell would not take money for it, and she wrote the receipt for twenty shillings in her husband's law-hand, counted twice. She will air the chamber, leave the coffer alone, and keep the cat off the book. At Old Swan you held the canvas while Gannet knotted it, for Wednesday's flood, six oars and himself. He had three pieces of news, and you did not yet know which third of them was true. You read the Rose bill. The title was New World's Tragedy. You did not go. At two, Errors went to a yard of some sixty, and Margery's stair took four shillings and tenpence. It was the Theatre's last play of the year. By dusk Heminges had it from Somerset House that the Queen has put off Richmond until tomorrow. The tilt-boat stands. You did not count the coffer. The walk home was into the wind.
one_sentence: You paid the Christmas quarter three days early, lashed Gannet's canvas in the sleet, played Errors to a thin wet yard, and heard that the Queen waits until tomorrow.
title: Twenty shillings paid, and the tilt-boat stands
